plan.notes: Source: TMCC official catalog 'English, AA' (https://catalog.tmcc.edu/degrees-certificates/english-aa/), 'Recommended Course Schedule' plan-of-study grid (English Career Map), hand-transcribed 2026-10-02. Per-course prerequisites are not listed in the schedule grid. This program can be completed online but may require in-person assignments or exams.
